notes.title: The Nightscarred: Forgotten Gods Is Announced!
notes.content:
Greetings,

We're happy to announce that [b]The Nightscarred: Forgotten Gods[/b], a new immersive first-person action title, will be released on [b]Steam[/b] and [b]PlayStation 5[/b] platforms!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/b1nH6M9.gif[/img]

While we don't have a release date to share yet, we're working hard to create a unique yet familiar immersive sim experience for all fans of the genre! Additionally, we're also working on [b]co-op support[/b] for the story playthrough. To address any concerns, the game will be [b]fully playable solo[/b], while co-op support being optional for those who want to experience the story with a friend in a more fun and chaotic way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056174/6af4680c3aa97c476183343e6b2a0239cd992d47.png[/img]
